title: AI coder license
description: Certify that a software developer has the training and experience to use AI tools safely while writing code.

t.description: Message type. Optional; an ACDC JSON message without it is of type acm.

u.description: Salty nonce that blinds this credential's SAID. Optional; ordinarily wanted, since the attribute block names a person.

i.description: AID of the issuer granting the license

rd.description: SAID of the registry whose TEL carries this credential's issuance and revocation. Required: a license the issuer cannot revoke confers privileges it can no longer stand behind.

u.description: Salty nonce that blinds this block. Required: the block names a person, and an unblinded block lets anyone watching the registry confirm a guess about who was licensed.

i.description: Issuee: the AID of the licensed developer

dt.description: When the license was issued, as an ISO-8601 datetime

validFrom.description: When the license begins conferring privileges, as an ISO-8601 datetime. May be before or after issuance.

validUntil.description: When the license stops conferring privileges, as an ISO-8601 datetime. After it the issuer stops managing revocation. Absent means the issuer set no horizon.

issuerName.description: Self-asserted name of the issuer, for human readers. Carries no verification weight; the issuer is its AID.

issueeName.description: Name of the issuee as asserted by the issuer, for human readers. Carries no verification weight; the issuee is its AID.

d.description: SAID of this edges block. Optional for the reason @enr3eg made a.d optional: the fork's acdcmap emits no block SAID, so requiring one would reject every edge-bearing credential an issuer can actually build.

issuer.description: Edge to a credential that establishes who the issuer is

n.description: SAID of a credential that proves the issuer's identity

o.description: Operator: the issuer AID of this ACDC MUST be the issuee AID of the node this edge points to

coca.description: Edge to the issuee's AI user code of conduct attestation

n.description: SAID of the code of conduct attestation

oneOf.const: The issuer certifies that the issuee met its criteria at the time of issuance. It does not guarantee any particular code, review or outcome, and responsibility for what the issuee writes with an AI's help remains the issuee's.

l.const: The issuer certifies that the issuee met its criteria at the time of issuance. It does not guarantee any particular code, review or outcome, and responsibility for what the issuee writes with an AI's help remains the issuee's.

oneOf.const: issuerName and issueeName are self-asserted conveniences for human readers and carry no verification weight. The parties to this credential are the AIDs, and a verifier that matches on a name rather than an AID has matched on nothing.

l.const: issuerName and issueeName are self-asserted conveniences for human readers and carry no verification weight. The parties to this credential are the AIDs, and a verifier that matches on a name rather than an AID has matched on nothing.

oneOf.const: After validUntil the issuer stops managing revocation for this license, so an expired credential that has not been revoked is not thereby current. A verifier MUST treat the horizon as binding and MUST NOT infer continued standing from the absence of a revocation.

l.const: After validUntil the issuer stops managing revocation for this license, so an expired credential that has not been revoked is not thereby current. A verifier MUST treat the horizon as binding and MUST NOT infer continued standing from the absence of a revocation.
